Proudly Serves Bergen County, New Jersey & Rockland County, New York

Welcome to DB Heating & Cooling, Inc.

At DB Heating & Cooling, Inc., of Bergen County, NJ, surrounding areas, and Rockland County, NY, we provide exceptional service for your heating and air conditioning systems. We install new systems, maintain, repair, and if needed replace your current comfort system.

Whether you’re looking for residential, commercial or industrial HVAC services, DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. can handle the job, big or small. We are fully insured and EPA Certified. Our highly experienced and courteous technicians offer personalized service and free written estimates. Call us today for all of your Bergen County, NJ and Rockland County, NY HVAC contractor needs!

Call DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. today! Free estimates on new equipment!

 
 

We accept the following payment types:

 
Visa
 
MasterCard
 
American Express
 
Discover
Cash
LIVE LIFE COMFORTABLY
Air Conditioning

DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. installs a variety of air conditioning systems that will suit your cooling needs. We install or repair central AC systems, heat pumps, ductless mini split systems, and more! Call us today!

Learn More

 
Heating

If you are looking for heating installation, maintenance, and repair services in the area, call DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. We offer 24/7 emergency repairs and maintenance agreements. Call us any time to learn more about our comprehensive heating services.

Learn More

 
Ductless Heating & A/C

DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. offers ductless heating and cooling installation and replacement throughout Bergen County, NJ and Rockland County, NY. Get all the benefits of a high efficiency system without the hassle of installing ductwork. Call us for all your ductless heating & cooling needs!

Learn More

 
Indoor Air Quality

Do you want to save energy and lower your utility bills? Call the home energy experts at DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. We offer energy audits and installations on a variety of high-efficiency heating and air conditioning systems. Call any time for a consultation.

Learn More

 
Commercial Services

Our commercial services include energy management and HVAC installations, replacements, maintenance and repairs. We service all makes and models. Don’t hesitate to call us any time night or day for our 24/7 commercial repairs.

Learn More

What's New at DB Heating & Cooling, Inc.?
Do Heat Pumps Work in New Jersey Winters? What Homeowners Should Know

OCTOBER 9, 2026: Can a heat pump handle a New Jersey winter? Learn what Bergen County homeowners should know and compare your options with DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. today.

View All Articles

Preventative Maintenance

DB Heating and Cooling, Inc. offers annual Preventative Maintenance Agreements, to help you get the most out of your HVAC system and ensure your home and family maintain a year round comfort level. Twice a year DB Heating and Cooling will contact you to schedule your Preventative Maintenance, once in the spring to ensure your air conditioning equipment is ready for summer use, and once in the fall to make sure your heating system is safe to operate and perform at maximum level.

Learn More

About Us

We at DB Heating & Cooling, Inc., servicing Bergen County and Rockland County, NJ and the surrounding areas of Westwood, Oradell and Emerson., provide exceptional service for your heating and air conditioning systems. We install, service and repair air conditioners, furnaces, heating units, thermostats and heat pumps. Residential, commercial or industrial HVAC services, DB Heating & Cooling, Inc. can handle the job, big or small. We are fully insured and EPA Certified.

Our goal has been to ensure the complete satisfaction of every client, while offering knowledgeable and friendly service at competitive rates. Our hope is that you’ll feel confident in our ability to meet all of your expectations, and know that our customers are always our number one priority.

Our highly experienced and courteous technicians offer personalized service and free written estimates. We are proud to partner with other companies for electrical and plumbing work. We price the work by the job, not the hour so you’ll always know up front what the cost will be. We have no travel charges.  We offer convenient payment options and financing is available with approved credit. Contact us for details.
